high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a tweet from a Twitter user named Deedy (@deedydas). The tweet discusses the quality of courses offered by Stanford Computer Science, highlighting that their classes update within months of real-world research, which is not common at most other top universities. It also mentions that "premier" institutions in other countries can sometimes be 15-25 years out of date. The tweet includes a graph titled "RLHF: gains," which appears to be related to reinforcement learning for human feedback (RLHF) in the context of machine learning and large language models (LLMs).
